title: 1946 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship

{{Short description|none}} {{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}} {{Infobox Hurling All-Ireland | year = 1946 | image = | dates = 28 April - 1 September 1946 | teams = 17 | connacht = | munster = Cork | leinster = Kilkenny | ulster = Antrim | matches = 16 | poty= | team = Cork | titles = 16th | captain = [[Christy Ring]] | manager = | team2 = Kilkenny | captain2 = [[Jack Mulcahy (hurler)|Jack Mulcahy]] | manager2 = | totalgoals = | totalpoints = | topscorer = [[Paddy O'Brien (Kilkenny hurler)|Paddy O'Brien]] (7–3) | previous = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1945|1945]] | next = [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1947|1947]] }} The '''All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1946''' was the 60th series of the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship]], [[Ireland]]'s premier [[hurling]] [[single-elimination tournament|knock-out competition]]. [[Cork GAA|Cork]] won the championship, beating [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkeny]] 7–5 to 3–8 in the [[1946 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final|final]] at [[Croke Park]], [[Dublin]]. ==Format== The All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship was run on a provincial basis as usual. All games were played on a knockout basis, whereby once a team lost they were eliminated from the championship. The format for the All-Ireland series of games ran as follows: * The winners of the [[Munster Senior Hurling Championship|Munster Championship]] advanced directly to one of the All-Ireland semi-finals. * The winners of the [[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship|Leinster Championship]] advanced directly to the second All-Ireland semi-final. * [[Antrim GAA|Antrim]], the representatives from the [[Ulster Senior Hurling Championship|Ulster Championship]], were drawn to play the Leinster champions in the All-Ireland semi-final. * [[Galway GAA|Galway]], a team who faced no competition in the [[Connacht Senior Hurling Championship|Connacht Championship]], automatically advanced to the All-Ireland semi-final where they were drawn to play the Munster champions. ==Provincial championships== ===[[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship]]=== {{football box | date = April 28, 1946
